title: Pricing Policy of HDB's BTO Flats
what_it_is: Pricing Policy of HDB's BTO Flats

sections.label: BTO flat subsidies and grants
sections.summary: New flats are subsidised below market, with first-time buyers getting grants up to $80,000, and BTO prices stay under five times median annual household income.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: A subsidy is then applied, so that new flats are priced at a significant discount to the market.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: The pricing approach is the same for Build-To-Order or BTO flats in mature and non-mature estates.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: On top of the subsidised price, HDB also offers first-time flat buyers, the Enhanced CPF Housing Grant or EHG, of up to $80,000, to give more help to lower to middle income households buying their first home.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Today, HDB BTO flat prices remain at less than five times of median annual household income or less, compared to other major cities in the world, where the ratio can be nearly 10 or 20 times.

sections.label: Million-dollar resale flat transactions
sections.summary: Resale flats sold above a million dollars are a small minority, under 0.3% of this year's resale transactions, or 38 of over 14,400.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: While there have been several resale flats with attractive attributes that are transacted at headline prices of over a million dollars.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: These transactions are a small minority, representing less than 0.3% of the total resale transactions this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: So, in absolute figures, it is 38 out of more than 14,400 resale transactions so far this year.

sections.label: BTO flat building numbers
sections.summary: 14,600 new BTO flats were built last year, 16,700 are targeted this year, and the number is calibrated yearly based on demand.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: For the BTO segment last year, we built 14,600 new flats; and this year, we are aiming to build 16,700 flats.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: And so, each year, we will calibrate the number based on demand.
